description: Election Commission - A Member of the Colombo Municipal Council has Vacated his Office of Member
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Colombo Municipal Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. It is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by the Returning Officer. The content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of an elected official, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
